## 1. Architectural Specification & Hardware Topography

### 1.1 System Topology & The Deterministic Path
To eliminate nondeterministic jitter induced by thread preemption, lock contention, and cache-coherency traffic (MESI invalidation storms), the engine is designed as an asymmetric, lock-free, single-writer pipeline utilizing the LMAX Disruptor pattern coupled with hardware-level kernel-bypass networking.

### 1.3 Mechanical Sympathy: OS & Microarchitecture Tuning
1. **Kernel Boot Parameters (`/etc/default/grub`):**
   ```text
   isolcpus=managed_irq,domain,1-8 nohz_full=1-8 rcu_nocbs=1-8 idle=poll intel_idle.max_cstate=0 processor.max_cstate=0 mce=ignore_ce transparent_hugepage=never default_hugepagesz=1G hugepagesz=1G hugepages=32
   ```
2. **CPU Pinning and NUMA Interconnect:**
   * All critical processing cores (1–8) are pinned strictly to **NUMA Node 0**, adjacent to the PCIe lanes hosting the Dual-Port Solarflare XtremeScale SFN8522 NIC and the Mellanox ConnectX-6 Dx RDMA NIC.
   * Disallow cross-socket Ultra Path Interconnect (UPI) / Infinity Fabric traffic on the critical path. Core-to-core signaling stays within the L3 slice ring.
3. **Cache Line False Sharing Mitigation:**
   * All shared queues, state rings, and cursors are forced to 64-byte structural boundaries (`alignas(hardware_destructive_interference_size)`), with a minimum 128-byte stride between reader and writer cache lines to neutralize adjacent-line prefetcher ping-ponging.
4. **Memory Subsystem:**
   * 1 GB pre-allocated static pages via `hugetlbfs` (`mmap` with `MAP_HUGETLB | MAP_POPULATE`). Zero demand paging, zero dynamic minor page faults (`sys_brk` / `sys_mmap`) during matching execution.

## 2. Production C++20 Algorithmic Core

The matching core uses an Intrusive, Zero-Allocation Doubly Linked List for each price level within a dense circular bitmapped ladder, combined with a compile-time configured Memory Slab.

using OrderId  = uint64_t;
using Price    = uint64_t;
using Quantity = uint32_t;
using Sequence = uint64_t;

enum class Side : uint8_t {
    BUY  = 0,
    SELL = 1
};

enum class OrderType : uint8_t {
    LIMIT  = 0,
    MARKET = 1,
    CANCEL = 2
};

#pragma pack(push, 1)
struct InboundCommand {
    Sequence  sequence;
    OrderId   order_id;
    Price     price;
    Quantity  qty;
    Side      side;
    OrderType type;
    uint8_t   padding[6];
};

struct ExecutionReport {
    OrderId  maker_order_id;
    OrderId  taker_order_id;
    Price    execution_price;
    Quantity executed_qty;
    Quantity leaves_qty;
    Side     taker_side;
    bool     fully_filled;
};
#pragma pack(pop)

// ============================================================================
// HIGH-PERFORMANCE INTUSIVE MEMORY POOL & RING BUFFER
// ============================================================================
struct alignas(std::hardware_destructive_interference_size) Order {
    OrderId   order_id;
    Price     price;
    Quantity  open_qty;
    Quantity  executed_qty;
    Side      side;
    uint32_t  next_idx;
    uint32_t  prev_idx;
};

class OrderMemoryPool {
public:
    OrderMemoryPool() : free_head_(1) {
        pool_ = reinterpret_cast<Order*>(aligned_alloc(64, sizeof(Order) * (MAX_ORDERS + 1)));
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i < MAX_ORDERS; ++i) {
            pool_[i].next_idx = i + 1;
        }
        pool_[MAX_ORDERS].next_idx = 0; // Null terminator
    }

    ~OrderMemoryPool() {
        free(pool_);
    }

    OrderMemoryPool(const OrderMemoryPool&) = delete;
    OrderMemoryPool& operator=(const OrderMemoryPool&) = delete;

    inline uint32_t allocate() noexcept {
        uint32_t idx = free_head_;
        if (__builtin_expect(idx == 0, 0)) return 0;
        free_head_ = pool_[idx].next_idx;
        return idx;
    }

    inline void deallocate(uint32_t idx) noexcept {
        pool_[idx].next_idx = free_head_;
        free_head_ = idx;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] inline Order& operator[](uint32_t idx) noexcept {
        return pool_[idx];
    }

    [[nodiscard]] inline const Order& operator[](uint32_t idx) const noexcept {
        return pool_[idx];
    }

private:
    Order* pool_;
    uint32_t free_head_;
};
